decision: Driver: Reprimand (Driving). This is the driver's 3rd reprimand of the season.
fact: Car 23 exceeded the pit lane speed limit when leaving the grid on the Formation Lap.
offence: Breach of Article 44.7 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Driver: Reprimand (Driving). This is the driver's 3rd reprimand of the season.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, and timing evidence. The driver failed to set his speed limiter for the formation lap and under the regulations was required to maintain the pit lane speed limit until passing the pole position. In this case there was a radio failure and the team was unable to advise the driver to set the speed limiter. Subsequently he reached 92 km/h prior to passing pole position. As no sporting advantage was gained, a Reprimand was determined to be the appropriate penalty.
rules_referenced: Article 44.7 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 23 Exceeded Speed Limit When Leaving The Grid
